newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon ups Coca-Cola to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon ups Coca-Cola to buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers Friday raised its rating on Coca-Cola Co to buy from hold and set a 12-month price target of $60 a share.
-- Salomon raised its 1997 earnings estimates to $1.62 a share from $1.60 a share and set a 1998 estimate of $1.88 a share.
-- Salomon said the Coca-Cola's fourth quarter case volume estimates, which were released Thursday, showed that the company is back on track after the disappointing third quarter.
-- "Clearly, KO is continuing to meet its long-term objectives," Salomon said in a research report.
-- Cola-Cola gained 1-1/2 to 52-3/4 and topped the New York Stock Exchange's list of the most active stocks.
